notes: Tenant detail page: new kebab in the header with Edit display name and Remove tenant. The display name you set now sticks across every Sync now — Microsoft Graph stops overwriting it. The rename modal has a Reset to Microsoft name button for one-click revert.

Remove tenant runs the full backend cleanup (revokes active bundle assignments, audit-logs tenant.offboarded, clears the cached Graph token, deletes the row), then drops you back to the customer list. The tenant ID becomes free to re-onboard cleanly via Add tenant — fixes the 'already exists' wall you hit before.
